gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the government-wide Statement of Activities - Modified Cash Basis (pp2-3): charges for services 1,856,590 (Electric 1,150,238, Water 304,512, Sewer 297,696, Garbage 104,144) + investment income 212 + miscellaneous income 1,740 = 1,858,542. Detail comes from the Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7): total operating revenues 1,875,554 (charges 1,873,814 + misc 1,740) + investment income 212 = 1,875,766. The whole difference is charges for services: 1,873,814 - 1,856,590 = 17,224 (Electric 1,165,749 vs 1,150,238 = 15,511; Water 304,517 vs 304,512 = 5; Sewer 298,618 vs 297,696 = 922; Non-Major/Garbage 104,930 vs 104,144 = 786). Both totals are printed as such; the fund statement is on a different measurement basis than the modified-cash Statement of Activities. Every printed p7 line is already in detail; nothing missing or duplicated.

Statement total 1,492,739 is the Statement of Activities - Modified Cash Basis (p2) business-type expenditures: Electric 875,619 + Water 178,374 + Sewer 129,326 + Garbage 86,190 + debt principal 195,000 + interest and fees 28,230. Detail is the proprietary funds statement (p7): purchased services 820,293 + total operating expenses 648,881 (incl. depreciation 181,665) + interest and fees 26,750 = 1,495,924. The fund statement includes depreciation 181,665 and no debt principal, while the Statement of Activities includes principal 195,000 and no depreciation, and function amounts differ (interest 26,750 vs 28,230). Different printed bases; every p7 line is already in detail; no fix.
